1_executive_summary: P-01 — Multi-segment CSF shunt with Bayesian occlusion prediction and pre-emptive flow . A computationally verified P-01 technology (conditional on geometry/scope) with physical validation still outstanding. Current evidence: T2-CONDITIONAL. Transfer posture: READY_FOR_TECHNICAL_EVALUATION. Recommended transaction: CO_DEVELOPMENT with computational + clinical split. Validation cost: $3-5K bench + $50K+ for 3D multi-segment mesh.

3_current_alternative.strongest_alternative: Single-segment programmable valve (Medtronic Strata) — reactive, not predictive
3_current_alternative.alternative_weakness: Existing programmable valves are reactive, not predictive
3_current_alternative.why_inadequate: Whether multi-segment advantage survives a TRUE 3D multi-segment mesh (not flow-rate proxy). Implantable flow sensor doesn't exist commercially.

4_technology_advantage_hypothesis.hypothesis: Predictive shunt platform — first-mover in smart shunt category
4_technology_advantage_hypothesis.gap_filled: Reactive valves cannot predict obstruction; P-01 predicts and pre-empts
4_technology_advantage_hypothesis.differentiation: Differentiation hypothesis: Whether multi-segment advantage survives a TRUE 3D multi-segment mesh (not flow-rate proxy). Implantable flow sensor doesn't exist commercially.
evidence_against: FDA nozzle benchmark 72% disagreement (different geometry, not P-01's)
4_technology_advantage_hypothesis.unresolved_question: Whether multi-segment advantage survives a TRUE 3D multi-segment mesh (not flow-rate proxy). Implantable flow sensor doesn't exist commercially.

5_evidence_level.evidence_ledger_summary: MODELLED: 3 claims, COMPUTATIONALLY_SUPPORTED: 1 claims, OBSERVED: 0 claims
5_evidence_level.honest_assessment: Computationally supported. No external validation yet. Evidence ledger is transparent and auditable.

6_remaining_uncertainty.primary_uncertainty: Whether multi-segment advantage survives a TRUE 3D multi-segment mesh (not flow-rate proxy). Implantable flow sensor doesn't exist commercially.
known_failures: FDA nozzle benchmark 72% disagreement (different geometry, not P-01's)
6_remaining_uncertainty.what_is_NOT_proven: No external validation. No physical prototype. No clinical data. No regulatory clearance. No manufacturing validation.

7_validation_investment.success_threshold: Advance to next development phase (see Development Plan)

8_strategic_buyer_fit.ideal_buyer: Medtronic (Strata valve team), Integra Lifesciences, or Sophysa
8_strategic_buyer_fit.buyer_type: Shunt OEM with computational modeling capability
8_strategic_buyer_fit.strategic_reason: Obstruction causes 30-50% of shunt failures. Predictive multi-segment shunt could reduce revisions by 30%. That is a $124M/yr value opportunity for the shunt market.
8_strategic_buyer_fit.capabilities_required: Multi-segment catheter manufacturing, flow sensor integration, computational fluid dynamics, clinical trial infrastructure
8_strategic_buyer_fit.why_this_buyer_would_care: First-mover advantage in predictive shunt technology. Existing shunt OEMs have the clinical relationships and manufacturing base to capitalize. The computational work is done — they bring physical validation and clinical translation.

10_why_now: Obstruction remains the #1 shunt failure mode with no predictive solution. Computational power now enables multi-segment modeling that was infeasible 5 years ago. Shunt OEMs actively seeking differentiation in a commoditized market.
